posts.author: zestydoesthings
posts.body:
Hi!
Im using the default sideview battle system in MZ, with the Visustella sideview ui and I have a plugin request, I think?
I’d love to have the enemy battlers (just static pictures) move to the left/right by a couple of pixels every second or so, to breathe a little bit of life into the art. I assume this could be done with a simple plugin??
My game has a paper aesthetic so the characters are intentionally flat but I think a little bit of movement would be great.
I know that you can make animated battlers with visustella, which I will for my main character but I want to be able to change the enemies artwork mid battle (I have a plugin for that) and I don’t think it would work with that in mind.
Is this something that’s possible without a plugin or is a plugin already?
Thank you for any help!
